label: Denounce ICE — Republican tone
subject: CONSTITUENT CONCERN: Restoration of Order and Local Control in Minneapolis
body:
Dear Representative {{rep_name}},

My name is {{name}}, and I am a constituent living in {{city}}. I am writing to you today because I am deeply concerned about the current scale of the federal ICE and Border Patrol presence in Minnesota under "Operation Metro Surge."

While I value the importance of the rule of law, the current federal "occupation" of our communities has moved beyond standard enforcement and into a territory that threatens the safety and stability of our neighborhoods. As a conservative, I believe in the importance of local control and limited federal overreach.

Right now, we are seeing:

A Threat to Public Safety: The recent tragic shootings of Minnesota residents by federal agents have escalated tensions and created a climate of fear that makes it harder for local law enforcement to maintain peace.

Government Overreach: The reported use of "force to enter homes without judicial warrants" is a direct violation of the constitutional protections all residents should enjoy.

Economic & Social Instability: The disruption to our local workforce and day-to-day commerce is harming Minnesota's economy and creating unnecessary chaos.

I urge you to join other members of the legislature in denouncing the current scale of this federal surge. Please stand up for Minnesota's sovereignty and the safety of all our residents by calling for a return to orderly, local-led governance.

I look forward to hearing your position on this critical issue.

Sincerely,

{{name}} {{phone}}

label: Denounce ICE — Non-partisan
subject: CONSTITUENT INQUIRY: Ensuring Local Order and Constitutional Protections in Minneapolis
body:
Dear Representative {{rep_name}},

As a resident of {{city}}, I am writing to express my concern regarding the current scale of federal agency operations (ICE and CBP) within our local community. I am contacting you not as a partisan, but as a concerned citizen who values the stability of our neighborhoods and the integrity of our constitutional protections.

While federal agencies have their specific mandates, the recent escalation of "Operation Metro Surge" has created significant challenges for our local governance and public safety:

Public Safety and Local Resources: Our local law enforcement is being diverted from their primary duties to manage the chaos and public unrest resulting from these federal incursions. This is a strain on our local tax dollars and makes our streets less safe.

Constitutional Integrity: Reports of federal agents entering homes without judicial warrants and the tragic fatalities involving civilians raise serious questions about the protection of Fourth Amendment rights. A respect for the law must include a respect for the limits placed on federal power.

Economic Impact: The disruption of local businesses and the atmosphere of fear in our commercial districts are harming Minnesota's economic recovery and community stability.

I believe in the importance of local control and the principle that federal power should not supersede the safety and rights of Minnesota citizens without clear judicial oversight.

I ask that you use your platform to call for greater transparency and a return to orderly, coordinated law enforcement that respects our state's sovereignty. I would appreciate hearing your thoughts on how we can restore balance and ensure that federal operations do not further destabilize our community.

Thank you for your time and for your service to our district.

Sincerely,

{{name}} {{phone}}
